stories.story_fr: Au 1er trimestre 2021, Hamid Moghadam, PDG de Prologis, decrit une demande aussi forte que jamais vue dans sa carriere, portee par des chaines logistiques qui se reoutillent pour une execution plus rapide.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2021 Prologis chairman and CEO Hamid Moghadam called demand as strong as he had seen in his career, driven by supply chains retooling for faster fulfillment and resilience.
stories.signal: The robust demand from the fourth quarter has carried into 2021 and is as strong as I have seen in my career

stories.short: Plus gros leve de capital tiers
stories.story_fr: En 2019, Prologis a leve 6,5 milliards de dollars dans son activite Strategic Capital, sa plus importante levee de capitaux tiers jamais realisee, soulignant la force de sa plateforme de gestion.
stories.story_en: In 2019 Prologis raised $6.5 billion in its Strategic Capital business, its largest third-party capital raise ever.
stories.signal: we raised $6.5 billion in our Strategic Capital business, our largest third-party capital raise ever

stories.story_fr: A fin juin 2020, la capacite d'investissement combinee de Prologis et de ses vehicules open-ended depasse 13 milliards de dollars, lui donnant les moyens de saisir les opportunites du cycle e-commerce.
stories.story_en: At June 30, 2020 the combined investment capacity of Prologis and its open-ended vehicles was over $13 billion.
stories.signal: The combined investment capacity of Prologis and its open-ended vehicles, at levels in line with their current credit ratings, is over $13 billion.
